# architecture: scaffold
# generated by scaffold; edit the board, not this file

module board  @id m_board
  notes: The board model shared by the UI and the server (src/board.ts).
  const BLOCK_KINDS: Kind[] = entry, library, service, constant, type, interface, class, field, function, module  @id k_kinds
  const EDGE_KINDS: EdgeKind[] = inherits, implements, imports, uses, calls, returns, emits, handles, other  @id k_edges
  type Board struct  @id t_board
    members:
      - version: 1
      - name: string
      - blocks: Block[]
      - edges: Edge[]
      - target?: Target
  type Target struct  @id t_target
    members:
      - repo: string (relative to the board file)
      - checks: string[][]
  fn canContain(parent kind, child kind) -> bool  @id f_contain
    intent: Says whether a container kind may hold a child kind: modules hold anything, classes hold const/type/field/fn, interfaces hold fn.
  fn duplicate(board, ids) -> { board, copies }  @id f_dup
    intent: Copies the chosen blocks with everything inside them under fresh ids, plus edges between copied blocks; top-level copies are nudged.
  fn newBlock(kind, position) -> Block  @id f_newblock
    intent: Creates a block of the kind with a fresh id and sensible empty fields.

module claude  @id m_claude
  notes: The real agent runner (src/claude.ts).
  fn claudeRunner(job) -> { exitCode, output }  @id f_runner
    intent: Runs claude -p with the prompt on stdin, auto-accepting edits in the working folder and only the allowed tools, streaming progress and stopping on abort.

module generate  @id m_generate
  notes: Runs the agent and judges its work (src/generate.ts).
  -> uses prompts (@id m_prompts)  @edge e_s2
  fn generate({ arch, lang, outDir, runner, verify?, onProgress?, signal? }) -> GenerateResult  @id f_generate
    intent: Runs the agent in a fresh out/<lang>/<timestamp> folder, re-checks its claim with the language's checks, ties errors to blocks and prunes old runs.
  fn isRunDir(path) -> bool  @id f_isrun
    intent: True only for folders generate() made.
  fn runChecks(runDir, lang, signal) -> GenError[]  @id f_checks
    intent: Runs the language's check commands, returning their output as errors when one fails.
  fn update({ arch, repo, checks, runner, verify?, boardFiles?, onProgress?, signal? }) -> GenerateResult  @id f_update
    intent: Updates an existing clean repository in place on a new scaffold/<timestamp> branch, verifies with its own checks and reports the changed files.

module prompts  @id m_prompts
  notes: Per-language agent instructions (src/prompts.ts).
  const GENERATORS: Record<Lang, LangSpec> = python, rust, cpp  @id k_gen
  fn buildPrompt(lang, archFile, resultFile) -> string  @id f_prompt
    intent: Writes the instructions for generating a fresh project in the language.
  fn buildUpdatePrompt(archFile, resultFile, checks) -> string  @id f_uprompt
    intent: Writes the instructions for updating an existing project to match its architecture file.

module serialize  @id m_serialize
  notes: The board → architecture file renderer (src/serialize.ts); grammar in docs/adr/0001.
  fn blockLine(block) -> string  @id f_line
    intent: Renders one block's line without indent or @id.
  fn edgeVerb(edge) -> string  @id f_verb
    intent: Names an edge by its kind, or by its label for a labelled other edge.
  fn serialize(board, lang?) -> { arch, warnings }  @id f_serialize
    intent: Renders the board as the deterministic architecture file and lists lossy-mapping warnings for the language.
  fn signatureText(signature) -> string  @id f_sig
    intent: Normalises a loose signature so its parameter list is always parenthesised.

module server  @id m_server
  notes: The local API, as a Vite dev-server plugin (vite.config.ts). Every /api call must come from the app's own origin.
  entry http board  @id e_board
    detail: GET/POST /api/board?path=… loads or saves a board file
    -> calls loadBoard (@id f_load)  @edge e_s6
    -> calls saveBoard (@id f_save)  @edge e_s7
  entry http cancel  @id e_cancel
    detail: POST /api/generate/cancel aborts the current run
  entry http generate  @id e_gen
    detail: POST /api/generate?path=… saves the board, then streams progress and one done result as SSE; one run at a time
    -> uses claudeRunner (@id f_runner)  @edge e_s5
    -> calls generate (@id f_generate)  @edge e_s3
    -> calls update (@id f_update)  @edge e_s4
  entry http open  @id e_open
    detail: POST /api/open opens a finished run folder in the file manager
    -> calls isRunDir (@id f_isrun)  @edge e_s10

module store  @id m_store
  notes: Board files on disk (src/store.ts).
  -> uses serialize (@id m_serialize)  @edge e_s1
  fn loadBoard(path) -> Board  @id f_load
    intent: Reads and validates a board file, failing with a readable error.
  fn saveBoard(path, board)  @id f_save
    intent: Validates and writes the board file and its derived .arch.md next to it, creating the folder.
  fn validate(data) -> Board  @id f_validate
    intent: Checks everything the serializer and UI rely on: version, kinds and their fields, containment, cycles, edges, target.

module ui  @id m_ui
  notes: The React + React Flow interface (src/ui).
  -> uses serialize (@id f_serialize)  @edge e_s8
  fn App()  @id f_app
    intent: The editor: palette, canvas with nesting and edges, inspector, live architecture file, generate/run panel, undo/redo and shortcuts.
    -> calls generate (@id e_gen)  @edge e_s9
  fn BoardInspector({ target, onChange })  @id f_binsp
    intent: Edits where Generate sends the board: a new project, or an existing repository with its check commands.
  fn Inspector({ block, onChange })  @id f_insp
    intent: Edits a block's kind-specific fields and notes.
  fn RunPanel({ run, onFocus, nameOf, onOpen })  @id f_runpanel
    intent: Shows a run's status, branch, folder, errors linked to their blocks, files and live progress.
